# delete_agent_tool

> Delete/remove an existing LLM agent by name.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `agents` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=delete_agent_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Delete/remove an existing LLM agent by name. This tool permanently removes an agent 
and all its configurations from the system.

IMPORTANT:
- This action is PERMANENT and cannot be undone
- The agent's associated custom tools and resources are NOT deleted (they may be used by other agents)
- The agent's conversation history is preserved
- Any scheduled or pending runs will be cancelled

RECOMMENDED WORKFLOW:
1. Use list_available_agents_tool to confirm the agent exists
2. Use this delete_agent_tool with the agent name
3. Optionally use list_available_agents_tool again to confirm deletion

REQUIRED FIELD:
- agent_name: The name of the agent to delete (must exist)

EXAMPLE:
{
  "agent_name": "my_agent"
}

SAFETY:
- Only agents in your tenant can be deleted
- System agents cannot be deleted through this tool
- Consider exporting the agent configuration before deletion if you may need it later

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `agent_name` | string | yes | The name of the agent to delete. |
